missions.name: First Contact
missions.briefing: A hostile commander has dug in across the basin. Establish your base, keep the harvesters running, and wipe them out.
missions.objectiveText: Destroy every enemy unit and structure.

missions.name: Hold the Line
missions.briefing: Enemy pressure is building. Fortify the approach, protect your economy, and outlast the assault.

missions.name: Break Their Base
missions.briefing: Strike the heart of the enemy base. Destroy their Construction Yard and they cannot rebuild.

missions.name: Iron Tide
missions.briefing: The Syndicate is spending everything to break you. Hold the basin and keep your economy alive.

missions.name: The Last Compact
missions.briefing: Ashfall has committed its last field command. Break their yard and end the campaign.

missions.name: Industrial Push
missions.briefing: Three commanders contest the Ashfall works. Secure the basin and break their production.
missions.objectiveText: Destroy every enemy unit and structure.

missions.name: Dry Lightning
missions.briefing: No water, no cover, no retreat. Cross the flats and hit the yard before reinforcements arrive.

missions.name: Ridge War
missions.briefing: Three factions are fighting over the ridge lakes. Hold your shore and outlast them.

missions.name: Twin Blockade
missions.briefing: Two lakes, two fleets, one objective. Break the blockade and take the yards.

missions.name: Delta Run
missions.briefing: The delta is flooded and contested. Use the water or lose the coast.
missions.objectiveText: Destroy every enemy unit and structure.

missions.name: Long Front
missions.briefing: A six-way front is collapsing. Hold the line while the others exhaust themselves.

missions.name: Rust Bowl
missions.briefing: Six armies, no water, and one dry bowl. Break the largest yard first.

missions.name: Ring of Steel
missions.briefing: The ridge lake is surrounded. Take the ring and close it.
missions.objectiveText: Destroy every enemy unit and structure.

missions.name: Four Lakes
missions.briefing: Six factions and two lakes. Split your fleet or lose the shore.

missions.name: The Last Compact
missions.briefing: Eight commanders enter the delta. One alliance leaves. End the campaign.
missions.objectiveText: Destroy every enemy unit and structure.
